caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a chopping or cleaving tool. It consists of a wooden cylindrical handle positioned horizontally at the top, which is light brown with visible wood grain patterns. Attached to the handle is a rectangular metal frame that forms the structure of the tool. Connected to the lower edge of the frame is a broad, rectangular metal blade that is dark brown and shows signs of rust and wear. The blade is textured, indicating surface imperfections and usage over time. The drawing uses muted, natural colors and is presented on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorative elements. The artist’s signature, "SIMON CLEVER," appears faintly in the lower-left corner.
title: Chopping Knife
